questions.text: Sorry to land this on you. Someone's rung him four times this week, once late last night — could you find out who that is, please?
questions.hint: Open the Phone app and look in the Recent tab. Look for who appears most often in recent calls, especially last night.

questions.text: Adele Ruskin. He has never once said that name in this house... Can you tell me what she does for a living?
questions.hint: Open Insta and search for Adele. Her bio spells out what she does for a living.

questions.text: A literary agent. Hollis doesn't write, he marks essays. Sorry to keep asking — how many times have they met over the past 30 days?
questions.hint: Open the Calendar app. The 'Meeting A.' event from 16 days ago says in its description that it's with Adele — so every 'Meeting A.' is a meeting with her. Count all events titled 'Meeting A.' over the past 30 days.

questions.text: Six, and I never once asked where he'd been. I'm sorry — can you tell me how much of our money has gone to her?
questions.hint: Open the RevoBank app, go to transaction history and Look for a transfer to Ruskin.

questions.text: A lot of money, to a woman I've never met. That isn't nothing for us... Whose account did it actually land in, do you know?
questions.hint: In RevoBank, find the $1,200 transfer to Ruskin Literary and look at the transaction details to see the company name on the account.

questions.text: He's been paying a press. I don't understand what I'm looking at any more. Can you just tell me plainly what he's done?
questions.hint: Open Email and find emails from Harlow & Vine Press.

questions.text: He wrote a book. A whole book, and not one word to me... Somebody must have been covering his classes so he'd have the time. Can you find out who?
questions.hint: Open Notes and find the note titled 'Don't lose this' — it tells you where to find the code that unlocks a conversation in WhatsApp. Unlock it and read what he says about covering the classes — his messages reveal his full name.

onboarding.text: I'm Junie. I've spent weeks sat at my own kitchen table at night, working out what kind of man he's become... I can't keep doing it alone.
onboarding.label: Junie

onboarding.text: Hollis and I hit our sixth year in the fall. He teaches literature at Braddock Trail, he's the steadiest man I know, and my mother rings him before she rings me. I thought I knew all of him.
onboarding.label: Junie & Hollis

onboarding.text: Then in the spring he started going out in the late afternoons. He won't say where. He sits up long after I'm in bed, and last night his phone rang and he took it out to the step.
onboarding.label: Hollis

onboarding.text: He's asleep now. The phone's on the table and I know the code. I hate that I'm doing this... Please just go through it and tell me. I want to be wrong.
onboarding.label: Junie

msgs.text: Hollis, could you look over the timetable for next week?
Admin moved a couple of things at the last minute
Hey! Sure, I'll go through it tonight
Is that for 5A and 5B both?
Right - Tuesday, 5A sits in room 12 now
And 5B Wednesday in room 8
Room 8 is the one where the projector never works, right?
That's the one. I've put a ticket in again
Third time this term 😅
Got it, writing that down
Thanks for letting me know
Oh and congratulations on the book!
Just saw it went through, they accepted it
Thank you so much!! Yeah it's unreal
This calls for a toast 🍾
HOLLIS!!! It just came up on my Insta 😍
They are actually publishing your book!!!
I could not be prouder of you
Remember back in school when you said you wanted to be a writer?
And here it is, actually happening!!! 🎉
Oh Robin 😭
Thanks love
Yeah I remember those talks that went till 2am
You always pushed me on it
Especially the stretches where I doubted all of it
Obviously! I always knew you'd get there
You had the talent the whole time
Just needed to keep at it
And you did! 💪
How are you doing though? We only ever talk about me
Same as ever! Well - new job starts in September
Wait WHAT. You buried that 😳
Haha I'll call you properly at the weekend and tell you all of it
Okay now I actually have to read it!
You'll sign a copy for me right? 📚
Of course - copy number one has your name on it
Signed by the author himself 😎
Haha counting down!
Hollis, quick one
Did the super say anything about the construction next door?
Hey! Nope, haven't heard a thing
What are they doing to it?
The whole stairwell is being rebuilt
Crews start Monday, apparently
Are they closing off the courtyard too?
No idea, the notice only mentions the stairwell
I'll ask the super next time I catch him
If you do, tell him the buzzer is still dead
Ah okay, good to know
So much for a quiet week...
Yeah definitely
Lucky you're off this week
Oh right! Hadn't thought of that
Ciao Hollis, how are you holding up?
Heard the big news! 🎊
Hi Marla! All good here, thank you
Yeah it's wild! Still hasn't sunk in
This makes me so happy for you!
A published writer, an actual one
Straight out of a movie! 😄
Haha, just hoping it doesn't get to my head
Nah, you're way too humble for that
Which is exactly why this landed on you
Are you running the Italian group again in the fall?
Sì! Wednesdays, same room as before
Put me down then, I've lost half of it over the summer
That's kind of you Marla, really
Hey are we still on for the meeting Thursday?
Yep! 3pm in the teachers' lounge
Great - Thursday it is!
See you soon! 👋
Hollis, my man!
No sign of you at the gym all week?
Hey Dwayne - sorry, no
Everything landed at once and I'm buried
Oh yeah I saw it on your feed!
Big congrats man 💪
That's a serious deal
Thanks! Yeah it's kind of nuts
Your bike numbers are still up on the board by the way
Please tell me nobody has taken them
Somebody has. Kid, about nineteen 😂
Right. Next week just got serious
So you hanging up the running shoes now? 😏
Haha no way! Just easing off a bit
Next week I'm back, promise
Deal - your slot stays open 😄
And congrats again on the book, man!
Hollis! Oma told me about your book!
She is bursting with pride 😊
Hey Gina! So the news reached you already?
She will not stop bringing it up! 😂
Anyone she meets hears that her great-nephew has a book coming out
Oh no... she's gonna embarrass me 😅
But it's sweet! She's so proud of you
For what it's worth, I'm proud of you as well
Even with how rarely we manage to meet up
Thanks cuz ❤️
We've gotta hang out soon!
Say when and I am there
Am I getting a signed copy of this book? 📖
UPS: your parcel arrives today in a 10am-2pm window. Track it with 1Z2847593621
Hey Hollis! Congrats on your book!
Nadia filled me in yesterday
Andre! Thank you, really
So Nadia was in the cafe then?
Yeah with a few friends
She lit up the whole time talking about you
Haha that's really sweet
Oh and your usual cappuccino has your name on it! ☕
Give me ten minutes and I'm there!
And this round's on us
Call it a celebration! 🎉
You're the best, Andre. Thanks
Be there in a few
Hollis! Bumped into Andre at his cafe
He said your book is actually coming out!
This is such good news! 🎊
Hey Nadia - honestly it still feels unreal
Honestly never thought it'd pan out
Obviously it worked out - writing was always your thing
You used to tell me stories when we were kids
Oh yeah! You still remember that
Of course! You made up whole pirate adventures
And I bought every word 😂
Haha yeah! Already spinning tales back then
Not tales, a storyteller! 📚
Is your mom still in the old house on Trenton?
Still there, she is never moving 😊
Say hi from me next time you're over
You have to walk me through how the whole thing happened
Coffee sometime this week?
Yes please - I'll ring you tomorrow
Great! I want the whole story
And most of all, to read your book when it lands!
Oh by the way
Am I covering for you again Saturday?
Yeah, if she asks I'm at your place. Thanks.
No problem
What's the project this time?
Still the same project
Just the final corrections
Ok, good luck with it
You're really saving my life man 😅
Congrats man, you pulled it off. Fourteen months later, and they said yes to your manuscript!
Thanks, it took work, but in the end it paid off
I still can't wrap my head around it
You've earned it so much dude
Do you remember when I got started?
Of course I do remember
You were up writing until 3am
And you had me cover your classes 😂
Who am I, Cal Yablonski — is there anything I can't do? 😎
Haha yeah, sorry about that one
You've been like a brother
I'd never have made it without you
Stop, you're gonna make me cry 😭
Are we celebrating this weekend?
Absolutely!
Are we heading to The Church Brew Works?
Perfect! Saturday 8pm works?
Deal 🍻
Just saw the invoice — you really went all out with those flowers 🌸
Had to get it right. It's the one for October 21st, no room for mistakes.
She's going to love it. Proud of you, man.
Verizon: your May statement of $47.99 is ready in your account. Payment due 05/15/2026

notes.title: Saturday French toast
notes.body:
You need:
- 4 thick slices of day-old bread
- 2 eggs
- 3/4 cup milk
- a spoonful of sugar
- cinnamon
- butter

Whisk eggs, milk and sugar together. Soak each slice. Fry in butter. Dust with cinnamon.
